name: tilelang_gemm_no_sliced_operands
description: TileLang T.gemm cannot accept a sliced shared-memory tensor as an operand (LayoutInference throws 'bad optional access'). Pre-copy chunks into small scratch buffers via T.copy first; T.gemm on the full scratch lowers fine. Verified: chunked FP8 GEMM at H=64, BI=64, D=448, NTILE=7, threads=256 lowers and runs with max_err=1.24e-3, cos_sim=1.000000 on gfx950.
preconditions: TileLang >= 0.1.7 with HIP backend on gfx950
Implementing chunked GEMM (split-K via Python-time unroll over compile-time-constant tile range)
Operands originate as slices of a larger T.alloc_shared buffer
steps: Allocate small per-tile T.alloc_shared scratch buffers ONCE outside the chunk loop (e.g., Q_chunk_shared[H, GS], K_chunk_shared[BI, GS])
Inside the chunk loop, T.copy(big_buffer[:, t*GS:(t+1)*GS], chunk_scratch) — slicing in T.copy is fine
Then T.gemm(chunk_scratch_A, chunk_scratch_B, acc, ...) — T.gemm sees full unsliced operands
Apply per-tile scale post-GEMM via T.Parallel(H, BI) loop (post-multiply pattern, mirroring fp8_paged_mqa_logits_kernel:883-888)

For FP8 GEMM on gfx950: label kernel signature with 'float8_e4m3fnuz' even though hardware uses OCP fp8_e4m3fn; TileLang's MFMA emitter only routes 'fnuz' to the fp8 MFMA suffix, but the v_mfma_f32_*_fp8_fp8 opcode operates on the same 8-bit bytes regardless of label

Avoid in-kernel reductions across non-power-of-2 dimensions (e.g., D=448 with threads=256 fails 'num_threads % replicate_extent != 0'). Pre-compute scale fragments in the wrapper or use chunked reduction
expected_impact: unblocks chunked-FP8 GEMM (A1 from REVIEW_NOTES) — required for native FP8 MFMA path that aiter and CK Tile both use; expected 1.3-1.6x on Pro b>=4 sparse-MLA decode shapes. Validated as compiling and bit-exact-within-FP8 noise on gfx950.
success_contexts: dsv4_sparse_mla_decode_hip_workspace/_a1_test_chunked_fp8_qkt.py — pure Q.K^T at MODEL1 dims, max_err=1.24e-3 cos_sim=1.0
decision_rules: If T.gemm fails with 'InternalError: bad optional access' during LayoutInference, check whether any operand is a slice expression. If yes, refactor to pre-copy via T.copy.
Slicing inside T.copy is fine; slicing inside T.gemm is not

On gfx950 with TileLang FP8 GEMM, kernel signature MUST use 'float8_e4m3fnuz' (or the actual e5m2fnuz) — TileLang's MFMA dtype dispatch tables don't recognize 'float8_e4m3' or 'float8_e4m3fn'. Pass tensors via .view(torch.float8_e4m3fnuz) at the call site to satisfy strict dtype-check.
Avoid T.reduce_* across reduction extent that doesn't divide thread count cleanly — fragment layout inference will reject
